name: Premise test, no custom build
question: Is oxygen exclusion worth anything at all over 6 h? Test the premise BEFORE building hardware.
rig: Entirely off-the-shelf homebrew gear: a commercial counter-flow wort chiller (or even an ice-bath coil) to chill shots fast, and two identical 5 L ball-lock kegs - one purged with blend gas to <1 % O2, one deliberately left on air. No custom coil, no instrumentation rig.
measures: Dissolved O2 at seal and 6 h (optical spot or handheld headspace analyser); 2-furfurylthiol and thiol oxidation index at 0 and 6 h only (4 samples x 3 replicates = 12 GC-MS runs); a blind tetrad on the two arms at 6 h with 20-30 staff/regulars.
pass_criterion: Inert arm retains >=20 pp more 2-furfurylthiol at 6 h AND the tetrad is significant at p<0.05. Either alone is a weak pass; neither is a hard stop.
kill_meaning: STOP. If excluding oxygen buys nothing measurable over 6 h, no chiller design and no keg system is worth building, because oxygen exclusion is the only large effect the model predicts. This gate can end the project for under EUR 3k.
derisks: The entire premise. Cheapest possible test of the one claim everything else depends on.

name: Dry thermal rig
question: Does the coil actually chill 1.48 g/s from 78 to 4 degC, and where is the freeze boundary?
rig: Glycol bath + coil + peristaltic or gravity feed of hot water at controlled flow; RTD at inlet, outlet, bath; balance logging mass vs time.
measures: Outlet T vs flow rate (1.0-3.0 g/s); outlet T vs glycol setpoint (+4 to -8 degC); time-to-4 degC; observed ice onset; pressure drop.
pass_criterion: Outlet <=4.0 degC at 1.48 g/s with glycol >= -2 degC, chill complete <60 s, no ice at the design setpoint.
kill_meaning: Coil undersized or correlation wrong -> lengthen coil or drop bore; re-enter D2.
derisks: Dean-flow heat transfer estimate; the 12 K setpoint window; the 60 s spec from the audit

name: Wet rig, espresso
question: Does real espresso flow stably through the coil, and does the coil change the coffee?
rig: G1 rig plus a real group head, a transparent inspection section at the coil inlet and mid-point, high-frame-rate phone video, and a dye-trace loop.
measures: Two-phase/slug behaviour on video; outlet T stability shot to shot (>=30 shots); carryover by dye trace; TDS in vs out by refractometer; mass balance per shot.
pass_criterion: No gas lock; outlet T SD <=1.0 K over 30 shots; TDS shift <2 % relative; carryover <50 % of one shot.
kill_meaning: Two-phase instability confirmed -> add back-pressure regulator, change orientation, or enlarge the hot-section bore; re-enter D2.
derisks: THE AUDIT'S NEW RISK: CO2 supersaturation and slug flow; holdup and carryover

name: Packaging integrity
question: Can the keg actually hold under 1 % oxygen for 6 h through real dispensing?
rig: Purged keg with a bonded optical O2 sensor spot read through the wall; blend-gas regulator; dispense tap; repeated draw cycles.
measures: Headspace and dissolved O2 at seal, 1, 2, 4, 6 h; O2 step per dispense event; pressure decay; dissolved CO2 at seal and 6 h.
pass_criterion: Dissolved O2 rise <=0.6 mg/L over 6 h including >=20 dispense events; pressure decay <1 psi/h; CO2 within 20 % of as-brewed.
kill_meaning: Seal/dispense design leaks -> fix fittings and purge sequence. This is a plumbing failure, not a concept failure.
derisks: The 34x oxygen-budget claim; whether pressure dispense really protects the last pour

name: Chemistry hold trial
question: Does excluding oxygen measurably preserve the coffee over 4-6 h? (the core hypothesis)
rig: Two arms only: inline-chilled + inert flush vs inline-chilled + air headspace, both 4 degC. 3 batch replicates, destructive sampling, one vessel per timepoint.
measures: Thiol oxidation index (paired TCEP-reduced/unreduced), 2-furfurylthiol and methanethiol by HS-SPME-GC-MS at 30 degC, dissolved O2, CO2, TDS, pH, turbidity. Timepoints 0, 2, 4, 6 h.
pass_criterion: Oxidation index separates the arms at p<0.01 with the inert arm retaining >=25 pp more 2-FFT at 6 h.
kill_meaning: If the arms do NOT separate, the project's premise is wrong and the whole system is unnecessary. This is the real go/no-go.
derisks: The +40 pp inert-vs-air prediction; the 1.2 h half-life anchor; Ea indirectly

name: Sensory
question: Can people actually taste the difference the chemistry predicts?
rig: Central-location tetrad test, 60-80 espresso drinkers x 2 tetrads, opaque lidded cups, crema skimmed from every arm, all arms to 65 +/- 1.5 degC with matched dwell.
measures: Tetrad correct/incorrect; served neat, in a 6 oz milk drink, and iced; plus 9-point hedonic on the milk matrix.
pass_criterion: Inert vs air discriminated at p<0.05 in at least the neat matrix; no hedonic penalty vs fresh in the milk matrix.
kill_meaning: Chemistry real but imperceptible -> the system has no commercial case for neat service; may still hold for milk drinks.
derisks: Whether the instrumental gain is a sensory gain; the crema-blinding problem

name: Service pilot
question: Does it survive a real bar, real staff and a real rush?
rig: One bar, 3 weeks, logged. Staff trained but not supervised. Batch twice per shift at the 3-4 h interval.
measures: Chill-exit T logged at 1 Hz; headspace O2 at seal every batch; batch discard events; staff time per batch; customer complaints; cleaning compliance.
pass_criterion: Zero food-safety deviations; >=95 % batches inside spec; staff time <=35 min per batch; no increase in complaints.
kill_meaning: Works on the bench, fails in service -> usually a workflow or cleaning problem, not physics.
derisks: Everything operational: cleaning clock, staff discipline, frost, throughput

name: Regulatory clearance
question: Will the authority let you serve this, and under what conditions?
rig: Written HACCP plan + process description submitted to the local authority; may require a variance for reduced-oxygen packaging.
measures: Hold temperature control records, discard rule, purge verification, cleaning schedule, staff training records.
pass_criterion: Written acceptance (or variance) for a <=48 h reduced-oxygen chilled hold, in practice limited to same-shift use.
kill_meaning: MUST clear before G6 serves a paying customer. No lab result substitutes for this.
derisks: The pH ~5.15 / aw ~0.99 C. botulinum exposure that the safety track flagged
